primary_brand_color.name: Corporate Red
primary_brand_color.significance: Represents energy, dynamism, and historic cultural significance within Islamic tradition. It serves as the main anchor for branding and primary action items.

neutral_colors.description: Clean white background paired with deep charcoal or black for high text contrast. Soft greys are utilized for structural dividers and secondary text to maintain a modern, uncluttered visual layout.

ui_characteristics: Highly legible on small digital interfaces
Variable font weights utilized to establish clear visual hierarchy between balance headers and transaction list items
typography.brand_wordmark_style: Bold sans-serif with sharp geometric apexes matching the corporate BIMB logo.

visual_elements: 3D 'b' branding emblem integrating dual hidden moon crescents
Minimalist, cards-based dashboard layout layout to handle financial data cleanly
Smooth rounded corners on interactive modules and containers

user_experience_focus.navigation: Intuitive, flat architecture designed for fast navigation compared to legacy app iterations.
